description: SET ... TO object-reference (ISO 14.9.39 Format 5) - introduced 2002 (OO). Bound-arm gated: every SET ... TO shape parses as the one setToStatement rule (kb/Work PB4231), and the receivers' RESOLVED object-reference category selects Format 5 in SetFormatSelection (BindSetToNull for a NULL sender, BindSetTo for every other), so the gate fires on the BoundSetObjectRef node (0900). SR8/SR9/SR12/SR13 violations are COBOL0867; LIVE as of the universal wave (D-U7, DEVLOG 608).
vcr: M2 OO (roadmap Phase 3); W1.5 parse-layer mapping (DEVLOG 608)
